# tcs-format-series

Plans and builds an episodic training series with gamification and spaced reinforcement — series plan (episodes, recurring cast, points, streaks, badges), 30–60 s vertical nudge storyboards, flashcard decks and a nudge calendar.

Part of the **[Training Content Studio](../training-content-studio/README.md)** plugin.

## What it's for
Turn a course (several approved lessons) into a season: weekly episodes in any base format, plus short nudges that
re-surface key behaviours (spacing + retrieval), with light gamification to keep completion high.

## When to use it
- Use when the chosen or requested format is "series", "episodes", "campaign", "drip", "microlearning", "nudges", "spaced repetition", "gamification", "streaks" or "flashcards".
- **Not for:** a single standalone lesson (pick that lesson's format skill) or for the course outline itself (tcs-curriculum).

## Install
```bash
# whole plugin (recommended: scripts use the shared schemas/, kit/, assets/)
git clone https://github.com/TamerElsherif/tamer-skills && claude --plugin-dir tamer-skills/training-content-studio
# this skill only (instructions only; its scripts need the plugin root)
npx skills add TamerElsherif/tamer-skills --skill tcs-format-series --agent claude-code
```
Prerequisites: Python 3.12 venv with `tools/requirements.txt` (plugin root); keys via env or `TCS_ENV_FILE` (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for narration/transcription, `PEXELS_API_KEY` optional); Node 18+ and ffmpeg for video renders.

## How to use
```
/tcs-format-series <request or file>
```
**Inputs**

- Approved `curriculum.yaml` (all lessons with `formats` containing `series`, or the whole course on request).
- Each episode's main storyboard (built by its format skill) and `quiz.json` items (tcs-assessment).
- Personas (recurring cast), domain `scenarios.md`, `assets/voices.yaml`.

**Outputs**

- `series_plan.yaml` (fill-in `templates/series_plan.yaml`; validate with `templates/series_plan.schema.json`):
  season meta, episodes → lesson ids, recurring cast, gamification (points, streaks, badges, leaderboard policy),
  nudge types, flashcard decks (refs to `quiz.json` `flashcard` items).
- `nudge_calendar.yaml` (`templates/nudge_calendar.yaml`, same schema file `$defs.calendar`): dated sends per channel.
- Episode storyboards: `formats: ["series", <base>]` (base = explainer/cartoon/doodle/comic/…).
- Nudge storyboards `<lesson_id>N<n>.storyboard.json`: `aspect: "9:16"`, `formats: ["series"]`, 30–60 s, templates
  `chat_mock`/`email_mock`/`mfa_prompt`/`cartoon` (hook) → `flashcard` → `quiz` → `outro` (streak/points line).
- Fragment `templates/example.storyboard.json` (a nudge).

## Examples
**Example 1: Adoption campaign**
Prompt: `a 6-week series with weekly nudges and streaks`
Result: Series plan + nudge calendar (30–60 s nudges, flashcards, points).

```

```
